svg.text: What to CHECK in the AI-generated metric view

text.font-family: Liberation Sans, DejaVu Sans, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: The assistant wrote the YAML from schema + sample data. Review every measure expression before trusting it — the AI cannot know grain.

text.font-family: Liberation Sans, DejaVu Sans, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: 1. total_revenue must multiply quantity by price, not just SUM(selling_price) — a unit price summed across rows is meaningless.

text.font-family: Liberation Sans, DejaVu Sans, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: 2. NO measure may SUM(amount): that is the opportunity-grain value and summing it over transactions double-counts (section 8, Flag B).

text.font-family: Liberation Sans, DejaVu Sans, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: 3. Confirm the customer join exists — the AI first built the view WITHOUT it, because customer_id was missing from the fact at the time.
